in_sanskrit.name: ऋषिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Rishika is derived from the Sanskrit word रिषि (rishi), meaning 'sage', and the suffix का (ka), which is a common feminine suffix in Sanskrit names. Thus, Rishika can be interpreted as 'Goddess of the Sages' or 'Goddess of Sense'. In Hinduism, Shakti, the divine feminine force, is often referred to as the Goddess of Sense.
